about.hero.title: The Comprehensive Legal Intelligence & Social Care System
about.hero.description: Nyrava México is the unified operating platform for legal professionals, multidisciplinary social work teams, and civil organizations — grounded in verifiable evidence, Mexican law, and strict human oversight.
about.mission.heading: Our Mission
about.mission.body: Transform legal practice and social accompaniment in Mexico through rigorous, responsible technology. We provide attorneys, human rights defenders, and social work teams with a structured operating environment that turns complex case files into verifiable evidence and traceable care plans.
about.vision.heading: Dual-Core Architecture
about.vision.body: Nyrava México integrates two core operational pillars: Legal Intelligence (for evidentiary analysis, timelines, witness statements, SCJN jurisprudence, and motion drafting) and Comprehensive Care (for social case intakes, 7-axis multidimensional risk assessment, care plans, institutional referral networks, and protected community support campaigns).
about.why.heading: Why Nyrava exists
about.why.body1: Litigation is drowning in paper. A single mid-size matter can carry tens of thousands of pages of discovery, hours of transcripts, and years of correspondence. Attorneys are asked to hold all of it in their heads while opposing counsel does the same.
about.why.body2: General-purpose AI tools are not a solution — they hallucinate, they lose citations, and they don't understand what evidence-grounding means. Nyrava is built specifically for the legal workflow: evidence-first, cited by default, attorney in control.
about.howItWorks.heading: How Nyrava works
about.howItWorks.intro: A new user should be able to follow a case from intake to a corrected, versioned report without already knowing the system.
about.howItWorks.step1.title: Create or open a case
about.howItWorks.step1.description: Start a matter by naming it and choosing two settings that shape the whole analysis: Case Analysis Mode (Ongoing Case, for active case preparation, or Concluded Case — Legal Audit, for a retrospective review) and evidence strictness (Strict, using only direct evidence, or Exploratory, which may surface AI-generated theories, clearly labeled as such).
about.howItWorks.step2.title: Add case documents
about.howItWorks.step2.description: Upload pleadings, discovery, transcripts, and correspondence — PDF, Word, spreadsheets, images, and audio. Documents are not simply dropped into a prompt: each one is extracted, classified, and indexed before any analysis engine reads it. Image files are processed with OCR; a scanned PDF page with no underlying text layer is flagged rather than silently skipped.
about.howItWorks.step3.title: Nyrava analyzes the case
about.howItWorks.step3.description: Purpose-built engines examine the available corpus: procedural-compliance checklists, contradiction and dispute detection, timeline reconstruction, evidence-strength classification, jurisdiction and legal-authority matching, and case scoring — each one producing structured, evidence-linked output, not free-form prose.
about.howItWorks.step4.title: Review findings
about.howItWorks.step4.description: Each finding shows the evidence that supports it, a confidence/verification level, its relationships to other findings, any contradictions it's involved in, related risks, and — just as important — what's missing from the record.
about.howItWorks.step5.title: Review the generated report
about.howItWorks.step5.description: The report brings the case intelligence together into one traceable document. Every version is preserved — nothing is silently overwritten — so you can always see what changed between one report and the next, and why.
about.howItWorks.step6.title: Talk to Case
about.howItWorks.step6.description: Ask questions about the case in plain language. Talk to Case is grounded in this specific case's record — findings, evidence, and the current report — not an unrestricted general-purpose chatbot.
about.howItWorks.step7.title: Correct the system
about.howItWorks.step7.description: Found a problem? Challenge a finding or a piece of evidence directly in the conversation. Nyrava identifies the affected finding, validates the proposed correction against real evidence, shows you exactly what would change before anything is written, and — once you approve — updates only the affected intelligence, preserves the original version, regenerates only the affected report content, and records what happened. A correction never requires rerunning the entire case.
about.howItWorks.step8.title: Continuous Legal Intelligence
about.howItWorks.step8.description: A verified correction can become a structured lesson. Related lessons across cases can reveal a recurring analytical mistake. A recurring pattern can be evaluated — with real historical data, never invented statistics — for a controlled, human-approved improvement to how future cases are reviewed. Nyrava does not rewrite its own rules; a human always approves a system-wide change before it takes effect.
about.different.heading: What makes Nyrava different
about.different.intro: Nyrava is not “an AI lawyer.” It is legal intelligence and case-analysis infrastructure — built to support an attorney's judgment, never to replace it.
about.different.card1.title: Evidence-grounded
about.different.card1.description: Every conclusion is connected back to the source passage that supports it.
about.different.card2.title: Traceability
about.different.card2.description: You can trace any finding back toward the material that supports it, in one click.
about.different.card3.title: Versioning
about.different.card3.description: Previous reports and findings are preserved, never silently overwritten.
about.different.card4.title: Targeted correction
about.different.card4.description: A correction affects only the intelligence that actually depends on what changed — not the entire case.
about.different.card5.title: Auditability
about.different.card5.description: Every meaningful change has provenance: what changed, why, and who approved it.
about.different.card6.title: Continuous improvement
about.different.card6.description: Verified corrections can become structured intelligence lessons that inform future analysis.
about.different.card7.title: Legal authority separation
about.different.card7.description: Adaptive intelligence cannot silently rewrite the legal-authority database — that layer stays immutable and independently verified.
about.different.card8.title: Human control
about.different.card8.description: System-wide intelligence changes require controlled validation and human approval before they ever take effect.

about.who.heading: Who Nyrava is for
about.who.intro: Real intended users — this is not a claim that Nyrava replaces any of them.
about.who.item1: Attorneys in solo and small-firm practice handling complex matters.
about.who.item2: Prosecutors and public defenders working under caseload pressure.
about.who.item3: Litigation-support and paralegal teams inside larger firms.
about.who.item4: Investigators and expert witnesses reviewing case files.
about.who.item5: Corporate legal departments managing multi-matter litigation.
about.who.item6: Other authorized users working within a licensed attorney's supervision.
about.who.disclaimer: Nyrava does not replace a licensed attorney or a court.
about.whatNot.heading: What Nyrava is not
about.whatNot.intro: Being clear about this builds trust — it does not undermine the product.
about.whatNot.item1: It does not replace a licensed attorney.
about.whatNot.item2: It does not replace a court.
about.whatNot.item3: It does not create legal authority.
about.whatNot.item4: It does not make unreviewable legal decisions.
about.whatNot.item5: It does not treat every AI-generated statement as fact.
about.whatNot.item6: It does not silently rewrite its own legal-authority database.
about.whatNot.item7: It does not erase historical case information when a correction occurs.
about.whyCli.heading: Why Continuous Legal Intelligence matters
about.whyCli.intro1: Traditional software stays the same until a developer changes it. Nyrava's architecture is designed so that verified corrections can become structured knowledge about analytical mistakes.
about.whyCli.intro2: This does not mean the AI teaches itself whatever it wants. Nyrava learns only through controlled, evidence-grounded, auditable improvement — and every system-wide change still requires human approval.
about.whyCli.ariaLabel: Continuous Legal Intelligence loop: case correction, verified lesson, error classification, related lessons, pattern detection, tested improvement, human approval, future analysis improvement
about.whyCli.caption: Backend infrastructure only today — there is no lessons/patterns dashboard in the product yet.
about.corrections.heading: How corrections work
about.corrections.intro: One of Nyrava's most important capabilities, shown end to end.
about.corrections.step1.title: Original finding
about.corrections.step1.description: A finding exists in the current report, tied to its supporting evidence.
about.corrections.step2.title: User challenges the finding
about.corrections.step2.description: You tell Nyrava, in plain language, what you believe is wrong.
about.corrections.step3.title: Nyrava examines the evidence
about.corrections.step3.description: The correction is checked against the case's real, cited material — never accepted on the model's own say-so.
about.corrections.step4.title: Correction proposal
about.corrections.step4.description: Nyrava shows exactly what it would change and why, before anything is written.
about.corrections.step5.title: User approval
about.corrections.step5.description: Nothing is applied until you review and approve the proposed correction.
about.corrections.step6.title: Affected finding superseded
about.corrections.step6.description: The prior finding is marked superseded — never deleted.
about.corrections.step7.title: Corrected finding created
about.corrections.step7.description: A new finding carries the correction forward, linked back to the one it replaced.
about.corrections.step8.title: Affected report section updated
about.corrections.step8.description: Only the report content that actually depends on the change is regenerated.
about.corrections.step9.title: Previous report preserved
about.corrections.step9.description: The prior report version remains intact and viewable.
about.corrections.step10.title: Correction recorded as a lesson
about.corrections.step10.description: The verified correction becomes a structured lesson the continuous-intelligence layer can later learn from.
about.principles.heading: Operating principles
about.principles.item1.title: Attorney in control.
about.principles.item1.body: The tool proposes; the attorney decides.
about.principles.item2.title: Evidence first.
about.principles.item2.body: Every claim tied to a source passage.
about.principles.item3.title: Transparent.
about.principles.item4.title: Verified.
about.principles.item4.body: Authority citations are checked before they reach a draft.
about.principles.item5.title: Private.
about.principles.item5.body: Case content is not training data.
about.principles.item6.title: Honest.
about.principles.item6.body: We don't claim certifications we haven't earned.

pipeline.skip.constitutional.apelacion: Not applicable: an appeal is decided on the grounds raised against the first-instance judgment, not on new constitutional claims.

pipeline.skip.trial_prep.administrativo: Not applicable: a contentious-administrative nullity action (TFJA) is decided on the written record — demanda, contestación, documentary evidence, and closing arguments in writing — with no oral trial hearing.

pipeline.skip.trial_prep.apelacion: Not applicable: an appeal is a second-instance review decided on the record, with no new trial stage.
pipeline.skip.witness.administrativo: Not applicable: a contentious-administrative nullity action is decided on the administrative record and documentary evidence; there is no witness examination stage.
pipeline.skip.witness.amparo: Not applicable: amparo is decided on the challenged act and the case record; there is no witness examination stage.
pipeline.skip.witness.apelacion: Not applicable: an appeal is decided on the grounds of appeal and the trial-court record; there is no witness examination.

privacy.intro: This page is maintained by the Nyrava team to describe how Nyrava handles information provided by its users. This document is a starting point and should be reviewed by qualified counsel before being relied on as a final legal notice.
privacy.section.ai.after: page for a full description of how AI is used.
privacy.section.ai.before: When you run an analysis, the relevant documents may be sent to large-language-model providers under contract to Nyrava (or, if you bring your own API key, directly to the provider you selected). See our
privacy.section.ai.heading: AI-Assisted Processing
privacy.section.collect.body: Nyrava collects only the information necessary to operate the platform:
privacy.section.collect.heading: Information We Collect
privacy.section.collect.items: Account information — email address, name, and authentication identifiers used to sign in.|Case and document data — files, notes, and case metadata that you or members of your workspace upload.|Usage telemetry — routine logs (timestamps, error events, request identifiers) used to keep the service running.
privacy.section.contact.before: Questions about this policy can be sent through the
privacy.section.contact.heading: Contact
privacy.section.retention.before: Case data is retained for as long as your workspace exists. You can delete individual cases and documents at any time from the app. To request permanent deletion of your account and all associated data, contact us via the
privacy.section.retention.heading: Data Retention & Deletion
privacy.section.rights.body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information. Submit requests through the Contact page and we will respond within a reasonable period.
privacy.section.rights.heading: Your Rights
privacy.section.storage.after: for the controls that are currently implemented.
privacy.section.storage.before: Data is stored in managed cloud infrastructure with encryption in transit and at rest, per the underlying provider's controls. Access inside the app is scoped to your workspace using row-level security. See our
privacy.section.storage.heading: Data Storage & Security
privacy.section.thirdParty.body: Nyrava relies on infrastructure and model providers to operate. When you add your own provider API keys in the app, requests from your workspace may be routed directly to the provider you selected under that provider's terms.
privacy.section.thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services
privacy.section.use.body: Your case data is used to power the analysis features you invoke — extraction, timeline building, witness analysis, motion drafting, and report generation. We do not use your case content to train general-purpose models.
privacy.section.use.heading: How We Use Information
privacy.title: Privacy Notice

re.check.why.buyer_identity: The buyer's identification is required for the deed and the transaction filing.

re.check.why.corporate_authority: It must be established that the signer holds powers for acts of ownership.
re.check.why.fideicomiso: A foreign buyer in a restricted zone requires a bank trust under the Foreign Investment Law.
re.check.why.mortgage_release: If the property is subject to an existing mortgage, evidence of cancellation may be required before closing.
re.check.why.notary_assigned: A property sale must be formalized before a public notary.
re.check.why.predial_receipt: Property tax debt takes priority and can block registration of the deed.
re.check.why.property_verification: Without the public deed, ownership and the chain of title cannot be established.
re.check.why.registry_search: The lien-free certificate reveals mortgages, attachments and existing limitations.
re.check.why.rfc_verification: The parties' RFC is needed for the CFDI, income tax withholding and tax reporting.
re.check.why.seller_identity: The seller's identification is required for the notary to attest to the transaction.
re.check.why.utility_clearance: Water and electricity clearance certificates prevent the buyer from inheriting hidden liabilities.

mod.strip.title: Intelligence modules
mod.strip.subtitle: Nyrava automatically determines which modules apply to this case based on the available evidence.
mod.state.pending: This case has not been analyzed yet. Run the analysis so this module can produce results.
mod.state.timeline.active: Chronology reconstructed from the documents in the file.
mod.state.timeline.none: The documents do not contain enough dates to reconstruct a verifiable chronology.
mod.state.witness.active: Credibility profiles generated from testimony in the file.
mod.state.witness.none: The file contains no testimony or statements that would support a credibility assessment.
mod.state.witness.signalsOnly: No formal witnesses in the file, but the credibility agent identified observations about evidence reliability.
mod.state.motion.active: Procedural actions supported by evidence in the file.
mod.state.motion.none: The current evidence does not support any additional filing or appeal at this procedural stage.
mod.state.motion.suppressed: Evidentiary sufficiency is too low to recommend filings defensibly.
mod.state.evidence.active: Findings linked to documents and verifiable citations.
mod.state.evidence.none: There are no findings with a verifiable document citation in this file.
mod.state.strategy.active: Case theories and strategic lines derived from the file.
mod.state.strategy.none: The available evidence does not yet support a verifiable case theory.
mod.state.strategy.suppressed: Scores and strategy are withheld until there is sufficient verified evidence.
mod.state.deadlines.active: Upcoming deadlines identified in the case chronology.
mod.state.deadlines.none: No deadlines or future dates were identified in the file.
module.care.name: Comprehensive Care (Social Case Management & Care Plans)
modules.care.features: Structured intake with unique folio and urgency triage | 7-axis multidimensional risk assessment (safety, health, housing, legal, etc.) | Care plans with goals, milestones, and direct interventions | Institutional referral directory (DIF, CEAV, INM, COMAR, Public Prosecutors) | 6-tier privacy with psychosocial, medical, and child protection safeguarding | Talk to Care Case assistant for analysis and administrative form drafting
module.community.name: Community Support & Solidary Campaigns
modules.community.features: Case-specific and organization-wide solidarity campaigns | In-kind donations (food, clothing, household goods, school supplies, medicine) | Volunteer professional service offers with staff review gate | Direct linking to verified external fundraising without custody of funds | 4-tier public identity protection (Anonymous, First Name, Family, Full Name) | Multi-channel sharing with WhatsApp, Facebook, and QR code integration
